Regex-based minifier, safe for normal CSS. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste your CSS into the input box.
  2. Click Minify CSS.
  3. Review the original vs minified byte stats and the percentage saved.
  4. Copy the result or download it as a .css file.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What does the minifier change?
It removes /* */ comments, collapses whitespace, strips spaces around punctuation, and drops unnecessary semicolons before closing braces.
Is it safe for all CSS?
It is regex-based and safe for normal CSS. Very complex data URIs or exotic hacks could theoretically be affected — validate critical stylesheets after minifying.
Is my CSS uploaded anywhere?
No. Everything runs locally in your browser; your CSS is never uploaded.
